children: Strawberry Fields REIT completed a Regulation S offering of Series D bonds and Series 2 warrants in Israel, generating approximately $17 million in gross proceeds. The warrants became exercisable upon TASE listing and expire on December 30, 2027, with an exercise price of NIS 46 (about $15.12 as of September 15, 2026). In connection with the bond issuance, the company executed a Deed of Trust with Mishmeret Trust Services to administer bondholder rights. The transactions expand Strawberry Fields REIT’s access to capital through the Israeli market.
